candidates.title: First low
candidates.text: First low: a low row above every other level — added 2026-01-01

candidates.title: Normal one
candidates.text: Normal one: an untagged row below a low row — added 2026-01-02

candidates.title: Late high
candidates.text: Late high: a high row below a low row — added 2026-01-03

candidates.title: Second low
candidates.text: Second low: a low row split from the first by other levels — added 2026-01-04

candidates.title: Normal two
candidates.text: Normal two: a second untagged row, split from the first — added 2026-01-05

candidates.title: Last high
candidates.text: Last high: a second high row, split from the first — added 2026-01-06
